title: Manchego and fig chutney
ingredients: 12 thin slices French stick , drizzled with olive oil and toasted (crostini)
method: Put the onion, sugar, spices, ginger and vinegar in a pan and cook together slowly until the onion is completely softened.
Add the fig wedges and cook for another 5-10 minutes until the figs are just starting to break down.
To serve, top the crostini with a little Manchego, some fig chutney and a couple of rocket sprigs.
